fusions.name: Melt Through
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Struck Sparks
fusions.desc: Throws sparks in a cone that deals 4 damage to everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Sundered], its armour softened, for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Annealed Barrier
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds. For the first 5 seconds, it burns your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tempered Mail
fusions.desc: Conjures a suit of armour: every hit you take deals 2 less damage, your armour rises by 10%, and 12% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
